profiles.description: Authenticated hosted container deployment exposing read-only eBay listing tools against the external eBay provider.

providerPrerequisites.description: An eBay developer application and keyset for the selected eBay environment are configured for OAuth client-credentials authentication.
The selected eBay application has Browse API access and any provider approval required for its target eBay environment.
A production eBay keyset has Marketplace Account Deletion/Closure compliance completed through the hosted callback or an eBay-granted exemption.

identity.trustBoundary: Authenticated callers cross the public HTTPS boundary; the hosted workload identity is limited to its deployment image and secret references, while eBay access uses separate application credentials.
rbac: Pull the selected container image from the deployment registry.
Read the declared secret references from the deployment secret store.
Use the selected eBay application credentials only for documented read-only Browse API and Notification public-key operations.

authorization.scope: Read-only eBay Browse API access plus Notification public-key retrieval needed to authenticate Marketplace Account Deletion callbacks.

lifecycle.freshness: Read provider listing data on each tool invocation; only OAuth tokens and notification public keys use bounded in-memory caches.
lifecycle.cleanup: Persist no eBay listing, account, or notification payload data after request handling.

notReady.reason: Treat provider-backed behavior as unavailable when credentials, OAuth, or required eBay APIs cannot be used; process health alone does not establish provider readiness.
